requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Reduce the number of product name references for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series on 123.hp.com to a single, consistent name to prevent user confusion.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Ensure the printer operates reliably with all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media, meeting intervention specifications across climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The product must function properly and without hardware failure when placed and operated on uneven surfaces such as sofas, tablecloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess whether the printer experiences any functional failure when tilted 20 degrees left or right during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Verify that the printer maintains print quality and experiences no functional issues when printing while placed on a moving trolley.
